claims.text: An 8-year-old girl with a congenital single kidney and a history of epilepsy after encephalitis at age 2 presented to the emergency department with a 4-day history of fever and gross hematuria and periorbital edema. Family history included glomerulonephritis in a maternal uncle and recurrent hematuria in her mother and older sister.
